integrity.computations: Exact rational cut squared-distance enumeration and high-precision center constraints replayed from embedded verify.py.
integrity.historical_priority: Provisional; general graphical-zonotope cut formula is prior work, not a new theorem here.
integrity.proof_scope: All integer 2<=p<=q; exact spectral proof and cut-face classification; numerical checks are corroboration only.

limitations: Only unweighted standard graphical zonotopes with two parts of sizes at least two, and intrinsic Euclidean metric.
For general unequal sizes p>2 the complete center polytope is not enumerated, though its exact affine dimension and facet halfspace description are established.
Historical priority requires further independent literature review.
title: Sharp inballs and center-locus rigidity for complete-bipartite graphical zonotopes
